title: Vibe selection triggers Ozi auto-execute — user no longer sequences work
description: When a vibe is chosen at wakeup, Ozi scores the backlog (with vibe bias), presents a ranked plan, and executes autonomously. Stops at: context >= 50%, queue empty, or item needs user input. Skipping vibe preserves passive behavior. Implemented in wai.md Step 9b. Changes the session contract: choosing a vibe is authorization to proceed.
